author: BoldAndBrash
body:

replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
I don't think they should automatically receive a rank. I'm trying not to be mean, but it wouldn't be fair to the people who donated their own money to get the rank. And besides, the rank is supposed to show that you care about the server and you want to support it.

But I'm fine with the "RETIRED" Prefix. Not sure about the color of text, but it's a nice addition.
